title: Saona Island Tour
description:
**Your dream Caribbean escape, just a boat ride away.** Sail away to **Saona Island**, a jewel of the Dominican Republic nestled within the protected waters of **Cotubanamá National Park**. **Catamaran & Speedboat Ride** — Enjoy two scenic rides — one relaxing, one thrilling — to and from the island.

**Natural Pool Stop** — Wade into shallow, crystal-clear waters known for their giant starfish. A picture-perfect moment!

**Beach Time** — Lounge under palm trees, swim in the warm Caribbean Sea, or stroll along the untouched coastline.

title: Santo Domingo Tour
description:
**Step Into History and Culture in the Heart of the Caribbean**

Santo Domingo de Guzmán, the vibrant capital of the Dominican Republic, is the oldest continuously inhabited city in the Americas. As the birthplace of the New World, it is a treasure trove of history, culture, and stunning colonial architecture. The city’s historic center, the Colonial Zone, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site filled with relics of its 16th-century past. Among the most famous landmarks is the **Catedral Primada de América**, the first cathedral ever built in the Americas.

The city is a bustling metropolis with a population of around 3 million, divided into various municipalities, including Santo Domingo Este, the National District, Santo Domingo Oeste, and Santo Domingo Norte. While the city thrives with modern developments, its past is never too far from view.

**Duration:** 10 hours

**Departs from:** Santo Domingo

**Prices:** Adults (11+ years) $90 · Children (3–11 years) $45 · Infants (0–2 years) free

• Catedral Primada de América

• Parque Colón and Plaza de España
• A walking tour through the cobblestone streets of the Colonial Zone
• Time to explore local markets, squares, and cafes

title: Scape Park · Full Admission
description:
**Escape to Adventure and Culture**

Immerse yourself in an adventure that blends thrilling activities with a deep dive into the cultural heritage of the island. From exhilarating ziplining across cliffs to exploring hidden caves and swimming in underground pools, this full admission package to Scape Park offers an unforgettable experience. Glide through the air on water zip lines, bounce on splash hammocks, and uncover the vibrant beauty of this lush paradise. Along the way, you’ll also discover the rich history and culture that shape this incredible destination.

### What’s Included

All land attractions

Round-trip transportation

### What to Bring

Water shoes

Comfortable clothing

Swimwear

Cash or card for food, drinks, souvenirs, and photos

### Restrictions

Not suitable for people with disabilities, pregnant women, or those with major illnesses

Zipline participants must be at least 6 years old

Maximum weight for zipline: 330 pounds

No alcohol or substances allowed

Food, selfie sticks, and drones are not permitted in the park

### Included Attractions

**Cultural Route**
Step back in time and explore replicas of homes from the island’s past, spanning the ancient Taino Indians, Spanish conquistadors, African slaves, and Dominican peasants. This unique blend of history and nature is a captivating way to connect with the island’s heritage.

**Cave Swim**
Take a refreshing dip in a mystical underground spring, once sacred to native cultures. The cool, crystal-clear waters offer a truly peaceful experience, perfect for reconnecting with nature.

**Saltos Azules**
Enjoy thrilling adventures, including the Mabo rope swing, Macuya Swing, and Monkey Bar zipline. Ride water hammocks that splash through cool waters, surrounded by dramatic caves and waterfalls—a refreshing and exhilarating ride.

**Hoyo Azul**
Witness the breathtaking beauty of a turquoise cenote, a natural wonder that showcases the island’s unique ecosystem. This unforgettable experience offers you a direct connection to nature’s wonders.

**Zip Line Eco Splash**
Feel the rush of adrenaline as you soar across eight zip lines, flying above treetops along a stunning cliffside. This high-flying adventure is a must for thrill-seekers.

**Cave Expedition**
Explore the underground world, navigating a network of chambers and tunnels with remarkable geological formations. This journey into the depths offers an awe-inspiring experience of nature’s hidden wonders.

**Iguanaland**
Meet the majestic rhinoceros iguanas, native to the island, in this interactive exhibit. With trained handlers guiding you, you’ll get a closer look at these fascinating creatures in a fun and educational setting for all ages.

**Duration:** 9 hours

**Departs from:** Punta Cana

title: Higüey City Tour
description:
Step into the cultural heart of the Dominican Republic with our **Higüey City Tour**, a journey through rich traditions, local heritage, and breathtaking landmarks. This immersive half-day experience is perfect for travelers who want to discover the true spirit of the island beyond the beaches.

We’ll begin by picking you up from your hotel and heading to the historic city of Higüey, located just an hour from Punta Cana. Your first stop is a traditional Dominican plantation where you’ll witness how sugar cane and tobacco are cultivated and processed. You’ll also get to visit a charming artisan shop, where local artists proudly display handcrafted souvenirs, paintings, and unique pieces made on-site.

The tour continues to the iconic **Basilica of Our Lady of Altagracia**, one of the most sacred religious sites in the country. Take your time exploring this architectural masterpiece and feel the spiritual energy that draws thousands of visitors each year.

Next, we’ll head to the local food market, where you can sample a variety of fresh tropical fruits and soak in the authentic sounds and smells of daily Dominican life. Enjoy a panoramic view of the **San Dionisio Church**, a historic landmark said to be the place where the Virgin of Altagracia first appeared.

Before returning to your hotel, we’ll make a relaxing stop at the picturesque **Macao Beach**, perfect for snapping a few last photos or simply enjoying the ocean breeze.

title: Monkeyland Punta Cana
description:
Embark on a one-of-a-kind adventure at Monkeyland Punta Cana, where nature, culture, and wildlife come together in a fun and unforgettable experience! This guided tour offers the perfect mix of Dominican culture and close-up encounters with our friendly squirrel monkeys in a lush tropical setting.

### Up Close with Squirrel Monkeys

Step into the monkeys’ natural habitat and interact freely with these curious, playful creatures. They’ll happily jump on your shoulders, pose for selfies, and even eat from your hands — all under the supervision of our trained staff to ensure a safe and respectful experience.

### Cultural Experience

Your tour begins with a visit to a traditional Dominican countryside home. Learn how local families live off the land, grow organic crops, and prepare traditional products like coffee and cacao. This part of the tour offers a unique window into the daily life and heritage of the Dominican Republic.

### What to Expect

Visit to a Dominican country house

Cultural demonstration of farming and local products

Interactive visit with squirrel monkeys in a natural habitat

Tour conducted on 5 beautiful acres of mountain land

Available as a guided tour with transportation or drive-yourself option (please note: guided tour has a specific start time)

**Departs from:** Punta Cana

**Included:**

• Safari truck transport (if selected)

title: Ocean Spa & Doctor Fish

title: Parasailing
description:
Fly High and Soar Over the Crystal-Clear Waters of the Caribbean!. Get ready for an exhilarating adventure that combines the thrill of flight with stunning aerial views of Punta Cana’s pristine beaches! **Parasailing Punta Cana** is the ultimate way to enjoy the beautiful coastline from a completely new perspective, making it an unforgettable experience for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike.

Your adventure begins with a brief but important safety briefing from our experienced guides, ensuring you’re fully prepared for the flight. After boarding a speedboat, you’ll be equipped with a harness and parachute before being lifted high into the sky — over 100 meters above the Caribbean waters! As you ascend, you’ll be treated to panoramic views of the breathtaking coastline, white sandy beaches, and the vibrant turquoise sea. You may even catch glimpses of the exclusive resorts and the lush tropical vegetation lining the shores.

The parasail ride typically lasts between 10 and 15 minutes, giving you plenty of time to relax, take in the awe-inspiring scenery, and feel the excitement of flying through the air. For those craving a little extra adventure, some operators offer the option to dip down toward the water before lifting you back up for the return journey.

This activity is ideal for **families**, **couples**, or **friends** looking to share a thrilling, yet relaxing experience while enjoying the beauty of the Dominican Republic from above.

After your flight, you’ll return to the boat and can unwind while heading back to shore, reflecting on the unforgettable moments of your parasailing adventure.

**Duration:** 3 hours

**Departs from:** Punta Cana

**Prices:** Adults (11+ years) $75 · Children (3–11 years) $38 · Infants (0–2 years) free

title: Safari Tour
description:
### Safari Adventure Through the Dominican Countryside

Discover the heart and soul of the Dominican Republic on this immersive safari style journey through its rich rural landscapes. Climb aboard a specially equipped open-air truck and set off through the rolling hills and colorful countryside for a day full of cultural discovery, natural beauty, and local flavor.

Your adventure begins with visits to local plantations where you’ll explore how coffee, cocoa, and sugarcane are grown and processed three staples that have shaped the island’s history. Along the way, stop in the vibrant town of Higüey to sample fresh tropical fruits and other local treats.

One of the highlights of the day is the visit to a Dominican family home, where you’ll be warmly welcomed to share a cup of freshly brewed coffee and gain insight into the everyday life and traditions of the island’s rural communities.

Later, take in the fresh mountain air as you explore scenic ranches in the Anamuya hills. Cool off with a refreshing swim in the Anamuya River and enjoy a hearty Dominican-style lunch featuring traditional dishes.

The experience wraps up at the breathtaking Macao Beach, where you can unwind on powdery white sand or take a dip in the turquoise Caribbean waters. With stops for handmade cigars and sugarcane tasting along the way, this excursion offers the perfect blend of culture, nature, and relaxation.

**Duration:** 6 hours

**Departs from:** Punta Cana

**Prices:** Adults (11+ years) $89 · Children $50 · Infants (0–2 years) free

**Included:**
• Hotel pick-up and dropoff
• Visit to the basilica of Higüey
• Typical dominican lunch
• Fresh fruit tasting
• Visit to local plantations
• Tour of a typical house
• Guide and staff to accompany you throughout the entire journey

**What to bring:**
• Beach clothes

title: Samaná, Cayo Levantado & El Limón
description:
Samaná, located in the northeastern part of the Dominican Republic, is a picturesque destination known for its stunning natural beauty. Visitors can enjoy breathtaking views over Samaná Bay, where humpback whales gather during their annual mating season. It’s an awe-inspiring sight that attracts whale watchers from all over the world.

The tour takes you to **Cayo Levantado**, a small island with pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters perfect for relaxation and swimming. Here, you’ll have the chance to unwind and enjoy the Caribbean sun in one of the most tranquil places on earth.

**El Limón Waterfall**, one of the region’s most iconic attractions, is another highlight of the tour. Nestled in lush tropical vegetation, this stunning waterfall is surrounded by natural beauty and offers a refreshing swim in its cool waters.

title: The Fiestón · Catalina Island
description:
The Fiestón Catalina Island tour offers a one-of-a-kind opportunity to explore Isla Catalina, also known as Ikiita Island or Toeya by the indigenous people of the region. Located in the Caribbean Sea, southeast of La Romana Province in the Dominican Republic, this stunning island has become a sought-after destination for travelers looking to experience the authentic charm of the Caribbean.

Isla Catalina is famous for its powdery white-sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and thriving marine life, making it a perfect spot for snorkeling and diving enthusiasts. As part of The Fiestón tour, you’ll dive into the island’s natural wonders, including a guided snorkeling adventure at the “La Pared” or “The Wall” reef. This underwater paradise is home to a rich array of colorful coral, tropical fish, and vibrant marine species, offering an unforgettable look into the vibrant ecosystem of the Caribbean Sea.

Culturally, the island holds significance with its alternative names, Ikiita and Toeya, which are derived from the Taíno language, honoring the indigenous people who once inhabited the island. Throughout the excursion, guests may also learn about the island’s history and the traditions of the native Taíno people, adding a fascinating cultural layer to the experience.

Beyond the waters, enjoy a day of relaxation on the beach with access to beachside cabanas, delicious fresh seafood, and lively entertainment, including local music and dance. The Fiestón Catalina Island tour offers the perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and cultural exploration, creating a memorable experience for everyone.

**Duration:** 9 hours

**Departs from:** Bayahíbe

**Prices:** Adults $129

**Included:**
• Hotel pick-up and dropoff
• Speed boat ride to Catalina Island
• Stop at the spectacular natural pool
• Delicious lunch served on the island

title: Whale Watching in Samaná
description:
Between January and March, the bay of Samaná becomes the stage for an awe-inspiring natural event: the humpback whale migration. Our Whale Watching Tour gives you the chance to witness these giants of the ocean as they leap, splash, and sing in their natural habitat.

Your adventure begins with a smooth transfer to the Samaná region, followed by a picturesque boat ride into the bay. Accompanied by marine specialists, you’ll gain fascinating insights into whale behavior while enjoying the stunning views of the tropical coastline.

But this experience is more than just sightseeing — it’s a chance to connect with the wild. Seeing a humpback whale emerge right before your eyes is a memory that will stay with you forever.

To top it all off, many tours include a visit to Cayo Levantado (also known as Bacardi Island), a slice of Caribbean paradise with powdery white sand and crystal-clear water.

**Duration:** 10 hours
